items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Miss Kimmel used to kick about it... She didn't like it. No it wasn't that. She was glad to get a relief.

ctx.x: In other words when you switched the guitar they all let it down to fire.
I used to bring the banjo, yeah, but they wouldn't let me use the banjo. You know Miss Kimmel used to kick about it, that thing would probably, you know. So uh.
